levelScreen.howToPlay: How do you want to play this level?
levelScreen.disobeyedBody1: You solved the puzzle, but you did it your own way instead of following the instructions!
levelScreen.disobeyedBody2: Just like Naaman, we must learn to obey God's word exactly, even when it seems like meaningless extra steps.
riddle.enterPrompt: To enter, answer the riddle your teacher shared in class:
riddle.notQuite: ✗ Not quite — ask your teacher for the hint!
engine.followRules: Boxes are in the wrong order! Read the tutorial to learn the correct sequence.
engine.truePathDisobey: You chose the True Path, but disobeyed the order! (You must place Blue first, then Red).
engine.trappedWestDoor: You entered the West Door. It was the path of the world. Even though you solved the puzzle perfectly, you are trapped forever!
door.label: Level {n}
level1.tutorial.0: Welcome to Level 1! Today's hero is Moses, who received the Law.
level1.tutorial.1: In God's path, we must know the rules and not rush like the rest of the world.
level1.tutorial.2: Use Arrow Keys to move. Push boxes onto the targets.
level1.tutorial.3: Press Z to undo, and R to restart.
level1.tutorial.4: ⚠️ Pay close attention to this secret:
level1.tutorial.5: Most players rush and get stuck.
level1.tutorial.6: The secret in Round 3: Order matters!
level1.tutorial.7: You MUST push the BLUE box first, then GREEN, and GREY last!
level2.tutorial.1: Sometimes the world is dark and we can't see the path clearly.
level2.tutorial.2: Find the switch to turn on the light and open the gate.
level2.tutorial.3: God's word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
level3.narrative.0: Round 1: A humble start. You can move this box easily.
level3.narrative.1: Round 2: This box is too heavy for pride. Work together!
level3.narrative.2: Round 3: Double the burden. Stay humble and coordinate!
level4.tutorial.0: Welcome to Level 4! Today's hero is Gideon.
level4.tutorial.1: Gideon saw himself as weak, but God made him a mighty man of valor!
level4.tutorial.2: ⚠️ NEW MECHANIC: Gather strength (coins) in the early rounds.
level4.tutorial.3: In the final round, use the Powerup Menu at the bottom to spend your strength on Super Push or Wall Bombs!
level5.tutorial.0: Welcome to Level 5! Today's hero is Naaman.
level5.tutorial.1: Naaman was told to wash in the river 7 times to be healed. He thought it was silly and illogical!
level5.tutorial.2: Sometimes, God's instructions don't make sense to us at first, but obedience brings victory.
level5.tutorial.3: ⚠️ NEW RULE: You MUST follow the exact sequence of moves shown at the top of the screen. If you press the wrong key, you start the sequence over!
level6.council.intro.left: Walk through the West Door. It is the logical path.
level6.council.intro.right: Walk through the East Door. It is the true path.
level6.council.world.left: Good. Now place RED first, then BLUE.
level6.council.world.right: You chose wrong. There is no turning back.
level6.council.truth.left: You ignored us. You will regret it.
level6.council.truth.right: Good. Now place BLUE first, then RED.
level7.narrative: ⚠ High-value crates are tempting... but the floor may not hold them!
level8.defaultHint: Think carefully before you push... every move counts.
level8.hint.0: Think about which box to move first — the order matters.
level8.hint.1: Try working from the bottom-left corner upward.
level8.hint.2: The rightmost box needs the most room. Move it last.
level8.hint.3: Clear a path for the middle box before touching the others.
level9.narrative: 🔵 Blue may look small... but it's the only thing that moves what matters.

level10.narrative: 🌟 Everything you need, you already have. Work beats wealth.
